phases.title: Foundations
phases.description: Build accounting literacy — read a P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement, and trace how money moves through a business.

phases.title: Corporate Finance
phases.description: Learn how firms fund themselves and choose investments — capital structure, WACC, capital budgeting, working capital.

phases.title: Markets & Instruments
phases.description: Understand the instruments (equity, debt, derivatives) and the players — how sell-side and buy-side firms differ.

phases.title: Investment Banking
phases.description: Walk the IB deal process — pitch books, comparable company analysis (comps), and DCF modeling.

phases.title: M&A
phases.description: Learn how deals are structured and value is created or destroyed — synergies, due diligence, post-merger integration.

phases.title: Equity
phases.description: Master the equity research process and valuation toolkit (DCF, comps, precedent transactions) plus portfolio construction basics.

phases.title: Applied
phases.description: Apply it all to real filings and mock deals — read 10-Ks/10-Qs, practice deal exercises, prep for finance interviews.

phases.title: Advanced Financial Modeling
phases.description: Go beyond reading statements — build a fully integrated 3-statement model from scratch, layer in acquisition debt with an LBO model, and analyze credit risk the way a lender does.

phases.title: Private Equity & Alternative Investments
phases.description: Explore the buy-side beyond public markets — how private equity funds source and structure deals, how hedge funds generate returns across strategies, and how venture capital evaluates early-stage bets.

phases.title: Equity Research & Valuation
phases.description: Go deep on the analyst's toolkit — build a DCF from discount-rate first principles, run a rigorous comps screen, and use precedent transactions and trading multiples to triangulate an enterprise value.

phases.title: Structured Finance & Derivatives
phases.description: Understand how assets are pooled and tranched into securities, how options and Greeks govern hedging decisions, and how interest-rate and credit derivatives reshape risk across a portfolio.

phases.title: Forensic Financial Analysis
phases.description: Look past the headline numbers — detect earnings manipulation through accruals analysis, identify off-balance-sheet exposure hidden in SPVs, and spot the red flags that preceded the biggest accounting scandals.

topics.title: The M&A Deal Process & Due Diligence
3-Statement Modeling
topics.description: Build a fully linked income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement in Excel from scratch — the foundational build behind every advanced model, versus just reading one.

topics.title: LBO Modeling
topics.description: Model a leveraged buyout end to end: sources & uses, acquisition debt tranches, cash sweeps, and the return math (IRR/MOIC) private equity firms underwrite deals on.

topics.title: Credit Analysis & Debt Schedules
topics.description: Analyze a borrower the way a lender does — leverage and coverage ratios, covenant headroom — and build a debt schedule with interest, amortization, and cash sweep mechanics.

topics.title: Private Equity Fundamentals
topics.description: How PE funds are structured (GP/LP, fees, carry), how they source and screen deals, and how a buyout thesis turns into an investment.

topics.title: Hedge Fund Strategies
topics.description: Survey the core hedge fund strategies — long/short equity, global macro, quant, event-driven, arbitrage — and how each generates returns.

topics.title: Venture Capital Basics
topics.description: How VC funds are structured and how they evaluate, price, and structure early-stage investments — from thesis to term sheet.

topics.title: DCF Deep Dive
topics.description: Go beyond a basic DCF — build a rigorous WACC from scratch, stress-test terminal value assumptions with sensitivity tables, and understand why terminal value typically drives 60–80% of valuation output.

topics.title: Comparable Company Analysis (Comps)
topics.description: Screen and select a peer group, calculate EV/EBITDA, P/E, and EV/Revenue multiples consistently across companies, and build a football-field valuation range.

topics.title: Trading Multiples & Precedent Transactions
topics.description: Distinguish trading comps (current market prices) from deal comps (acquisition premiums baked in), and use precedent transactions to anchor the control premium in a negotiated sale.

topics.title: Securitization & ABS/MBS Basics
topics.description: How loans are pooled and tranched into asset-backed securities — the mechanics of cash-flow waterfalls, credit enhancement, and the key differences between ABS and MBS.

topics.title: Options & Greeks Fundamentals
topics.description: How call and put options are priced, how payoff diagrams work, and how the Greeks — delta, gamma, theta, vega — measure each dimension of an option position's risk.

topics.title: Interest Rate & Credit Derivatives
topics.description: How interest rate swaps transfer rate risk between counterparties, and how credit default swaps transfer credit risk — the instruments at the heart of fixed-income and credit risk management.

topics.title: Earnings Quality & Accruals Analysis
topics.description: Assess whether reported earnings reflect real cash generation or aggressive accrual-accounting choices — the foundation of any forensic analysis.

topics.title: Off-Balance-Sheet Items & SPVs
topics.description: Identify leverage and commitments that do not appear on the balance sheet — operating leases, SPVs, synthetic securitizations — and understand when accounting standards require consolidation.

topics.title: Red Flags in Financial Statements
topics.description: The warning signs that preceded Enron, WorldCom, and the 2008 crisis — rapidly growing receivables, channel stuffing, related-party transactions, and the Beneish M-Score manipulation detector.
